subject.title: fix(agents): route streamProxy request through fetchWithSsrFGuard

question: Should `streamProxy` always use strict guarded fetch with exact-host trust for the operator-configured `proxyUrl`, accepting fail-closed metadata/link-local behavior while still allowing ordinary private proxy hosts?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but the `allowedHostnames` policy is a security and upgrade boundary that can change existing operator proxy behavior.

options.title: Accept exact-host guarded proxy egress
options.body: Land this shape after checks are green, treating configured proxy hostnames as trusted private-network endpoints while retaining metadata/link-local blocking and DNS pinning.

options.title: Require stricter public-host policy
options.body: Change the policy to block ordinary private-network DNS answers unless maintainers want an explicit opt-in for private proxy hosts.

options.title: Pause for broader egress policy
options.body: Hold this PR if `streamProxy` should be settled together with the other unguarded fetch follow-ups mentioned by the contributor.

recommendation.title: Accept exact-host guarded proxy egress
